business_problem: StarLink needed to eliminate manual effort in procurement processes such as email intake, purchase-order validation, document extraction, and quote comparison without losing governance or visibility across enterprise workflows.
solution_summary: Through its Client Zero program with IBM Build Engineering, StarLink implemented agentic procurement workflows on top of IBM Bob and IBM watsonx Orchestrate. Bob serves as the AI development lifecycle partner that helps teams build, test, and deploy agents, while watsonx Orchestrate provides the governed runtime where those agents execute and coordinate work. The solution connects Oracle NetSuite, Docling, and Automation Anywhere so incoming procurement emails can be classified, purchase orders can be checked against ERP records, quote details can be extracted from unstructured documents, and accounts-payable steps can be completed without handoffs between disconnected tools. Instead of separate automations for each task, StarLink created a connected workflow layer that spans the full purchase-order lifecycle and can be reused as the company expands agentic AI to partners and customers across the region.

solution_components.name: IBM Bob
solution_components.role: Helps StarLink build, test, and deploy the AI agents used in procurement workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Runs, orchestrates, and governs the AI agents across the purchase-order lifecycle.

solution_components.name: Oracle NetSuite
solution_components.role: Provides the ERP data that the agents use to validate procurement information.

solution_components.name: Docling
solution_components.role: Supports document processing and extraction from procurement files and quotations.

solution_components.name: Automation Anywhere
solution_components.role: Executes automation tasks connected to purchase-order and accounts-payable workflows.

data_flow: Procurement emails and documents enter the workflow, IBM Bob helps create the agents that parse and route the work, watsonx Orchestrate coordinates validations against Oracle NetSuite and document extraction through Docling, and Automation Anywhere completes downstream processing for quote comparison and accounts-payable activities.
business_outcome: StarLink expects major time savings in procurement operations, much faster quote comparison, and dramatically shorter agent-development cycles, while building repeatable expertise it can take to customers across the Middle East and Africa.
